title: Momentum & Swing Trading
subtitle: Rank a universe on relative strength, time entries on the daily chart, size by ATR, and test the whole rule on real data with costs.
what_you_learn: The academic evidence for momentum (Jegadeesh-Titman, the 12-1 formation) and the specific way it crashes after bear markets, worked on 2009 sector data
Rank a 20-stock universe on six-month relative strength from Yahoo Finance closes and read the ranking honestly, including when it lags the index
Three entry triggers, breakout, pullback to a rising average and the opening range, each worked on real dated bars
Stops at technically valid levels and ATR-based sizing, with the share count and dollar risk computed for every stock in the universe
Exits compared on 100 real trades: why the trailing stop beat targets and time stops, and why no exit rescued random entries
A complete swing system backtested with 0.10% per-side costs, reported by year and by exit reason, plus turn-of-month and earnings-gap evidence you can recompute
